_comment: Blue Nova product import template. Remove this comment before importing.
_instructions: 1. Copy this file and rename it (e.g. my-products.json)
2. Fill in your products following the structure below
4. If validation passes, run without --dry-run to import
category: must be exactly one of: handbags | shoes | clothes | sunglasses
price / compareAtPrice: Nigerian Naira (₦), whole numbers only
hex: exactly 6 hex digits with leading #, e.g. #1A2B3C
imageUrls: direct links to images (Unsplash, your CDN, etc.)
sizes: use standard labels — XS S M L XL 2XL  or  36 37 38 39 40 41
isFeatured: set true for up to 4 products to show on the homepage

products.name: The Eko Bucket Bag
products.description: Relaxed luxury in vegetable-tanned leather. The Eko Bucket Bag cinches at the drawstring for a silhouette that moves with you — from morning meetings to evening outings.
products.materials: Vegetable-tanned leather, canvas lining, antique brass hardware
products.careInstructions: Wipe clean with a dry cloth. Condition every 3 months.

products.name: The Calabar Mule
products.description: A slip-on mule in buttery suede with a sculptured 5cm heel. Pairs with everything from tailored trousers to flowing dresses.
products.materials: Genuine suede upper, leather insole, rubber outsole
products.careInstructions: Protect with suede spray before first wear. Brush with a suede brush to restore nap.

products.name: The Lekki Linen Blazer
products.description: Structure meets breathability. Cut in 100% Italian linen, this single-button blazer drapes beautifully in Lagos heat while maintaining a sharp, professional silhouette.
products.materials: 100% Italian linen, fully lined in viscose
products.careInstructions: Dry clean recommended. If hand washing, use cold water and lay flat to dry.

products.name: The Benin Shield Sunglasses
products.description: Inspired by the iconic bronzework of Benin City, the Benin Shield features an oversized shield lens in amber or smoke, cut from a single piece of optical-grade polycarbonate.
products.materials: Injected polycarbonate frame, UV400 polycarbonate lens, titanium hinges
products.careInstructions: Clean lenses with the microfibre pouch. Avoid leaving in direct sunlight.
